findings.title: The page ends after the three facts, with no comparison and no second trial button

location.description: the end of the page, after the row of three facts

findings.viewer_experience: The owner finishes reading and meets empty space. Nothing says how this beats what they do today, and they must scroll back up to act.

current.value: the page ends after the three facts, with no comparison and no second "Start a 30-day trial" button

findings.target: a short comparison with the owner's current way of knowing their stock, then "Start a 30-day trial" again under it
findings.fix_direction: Add a short comparison with the owner's current way of knowing their stock, then repeat the "Start a 30-day trial" button under it. What owners use today and what it costs them are facts that only the maker has: the maker must supply them.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees, below the three facts in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a comparison with the owner's current way of knowing their stock and a second "Start a 30-day trial" button

findings.title: The table has no column for how many copies to order

location.description: the "Reorder this week" table, which has only Title, On shelf and Sold this week

findings.viewer_experience: A reorder list that gives no quantity leaves the owner to work out how many copies to order.

current.value: 3 columns: Title, On shelf, Sold this week

findings.target: a column for copies to order, or a statement by the maker that Shelfmark suggests no quantity
findings.fix_direction: If Shelfmark suggests a quantity, the maker must supply those figures and add the column. Otherwise the maker should say it suggests none.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees an order quantity column in the table in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, or the maker has said that Shelfmark suggests no quantity

findings.title: The fact row has uneven widths, which gives line counts of 2, 3 and 1

location.description: the row of three facts under the table

findings.viewer_experience: The row looks uneven. "Returns tracked" sits alone on one long line, and the first two facts are cramped at about 35 to 37 characters per line.
findings.target: three columns of equal width, with the third fact still starting at the table edge
findings.fix_direction: Keep the third fact starting at the table edge, but balance the first two columns across the space to its left, or set the third fact to the same 296 px width so the row reads as three equal columns.

closed_when.check: the three section.facts > p boxes in the desktop and widescreen viewports have equal widths and the third starts at the table card's left edge
